name: LightPillar-TS-TW
blurb: Rotating volumetric pillar with gradient colors and dynamic wave deformation.
description: WebGL-rendered 3D pillar with animated wave patterns, gradient top-to-bottom coloring, and optional mouse-controlled rotation. Adapts quality settings for device performance.
use_when: Abstract backgrounds, hero sections, or decorative elements where a rotating volumetric glow fits the aesthetic.
avoid_when: Low-end devices without WebGL support, or contexts requiring motion to be disabled — shader runs continuously at the quality setting's target FPS.
a11y: Passive visual effect; no keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
